title: Director Product Management – Product Pricing and Packaging Strategy
jd_excerpt:
Our Mission
 Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.
 Overview
 How you can make a difference 
 The Director Product Management, Product Pricing and Packaging Strategy is accountable for the pricing, packaging, and discounting strategy across HealthEquity 's core products, including customer segment (Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB), channel partner offerings, and pricing strategy for our Health and Wealth Platform. This role leads through evidence, product judgment, and influence, ensuring that portfolio performance and business metrics improve in ways that create sustainable customer and business value, and that pricing decisions ladder up to HealthEquity 's financial goals. The role partners closely with Finance to implement pricing policy, process, and operations.
 Reporting Structure:
 Typically reports to a Product GM, VP Product GM or SVP of Product.
 Is role a people leader?
 No.
 What you’ll be doing 
 Owns the pricing and packaging domain for core products, translating company and portfolio direction into explicit product choices, measurable outcomes, and a coherent roadmap.
 Works with the product managers across the company to decide pricing strategy for new features, functionality, and products brought to market.
 Define and monitor portfolio performance and business metrics, including price realization, discount rates, win rates, and margin; explain what changed, what did not, and how evidence changes the next decision.
 Works with engineering to drive the implementation of pricing and packaging.
 Integrates applicable pricing and billing decisions into product development from discovery through operation.
 Leads critical company initiatives across functions that have implications on core product pricing and packaging strategy, including “Be Competitive” initiatives, dynamic pricing, flexible client-configurable pricing and billing, customer segment-based pricing, channel pricing and packaging, pricing and packaging strategy for M&A, and our HealthEquity Health & Wealth platform pricing strategy.
 Engages with sales to decide and implement individual client-based pricing.
 Partners with the finance team to implement pricing policies, process, and operations.
 Key Initiatives Led by This Role:
 Enterprise Package
 Define and launch a competitive Enterprise package for deals.
 Use competitive benchmarking and win/loss evidence to determine what to bundle, unbundle, and differentiate, and where HealthEquity wins, loses, or is at parity.
 Set value positioning, price floors, and approval guidelines for competitive deals, and enable Sales with clear guidance and a deal review process.
 Mid-Market Pricing and Packaging Strategy
 Create a pricing and packaging strategy designed to win and grow in the Mid-Market, with defined segments, package tiers, and entry and expansion paths.
 Validate pricing through customer research, willingness-to-pay analysis, and pilots, balancing competitiveness, acquisition cost, and long-term account profitability.
 Channel Partner Pricing Strategy
 Define pricing and economics for each type of HealthEquity channel partner, including wholesale, referral, revenue-share, and bundling structures.
 Maintain pricing consistency and limit channel conflict between direct and partner-sold deals, in partnership with Channel Partnerships and Legal.
 Health & Wealth Platform Pricing
 As HealthEquity builds its Health & Wealth platform, develop a strategy to price to value of the platform.
 Develop the product requirements and work with engineering to implement this strategy, including feature-based pricing capabilities, feature adoption-based pricing and discounting capabilities, dynamic pricing based on member preferences and willingness-to-pay, billing options (including annual billing and bundled subscription billing).
 Client Configuration-Based Pricing
 Drive the requirements and engineering implementation of client configuration-based pricing, where individual client contracts can be set up in a pricing and billing configurator for automated billing, invoicing, and tracking.
 Discounting Strategy
 Design a discounting framework that ladders up to HealthEquity 's financial goals, with guardrails by segment, deal size, product, and channel, and clear approval tiers and escalation paths.
 Partner with finance to monitor discount leakage, price realization, and exceptions, and report results to leadership.
 Pricing Policy, Process, and Operations (with Finance) 
 Partner with Finance to implement pricing policies, governance, approval workflows, and operating cadence, including deal desk or pricing council decision rights and service levels.
 Define the data, quoting and CRM requirements, and reporting needed to operate pricing consistently and auditably.
 Guide the use of any HealthEquity pricing strategy agentic tools, including approved sources, rules, human review points, and traceability of agent-generated recommendations.
 What you will need to be successful
 Education and Experience:
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
 A minimum of 12 years of relevant product management, digital product, platform, financial technology, pricing, or comparable experience; equivalent combinations of experience and education are considered.
 Demonstrated experience building and developing high-performing teams.
 Demonstrated experience developing pricing, packaging, or discounting strategy for B2B or B2B2C products, including enterprise, mid-market, and channel partner segments.

 Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:
 Physical/Mental Requirements and Demands:
 Work requires normal range of hearing, vision and verbal communication skills, with or without a reasonable accommodation.
 Must be able to use a telephone or headset equipment and operate a keyboard and other office equipment, with or without reasonable accommodation.
 Must be able to spend prolonged periods of each workday on the phone.
 The ability to perform work at a computer station for 6-8+ hours a day and function in an environment with frequent interruptions is required.
 Must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs.
 May experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.
 To help you succeed in your role and ensure member information stays protected, we require that you maintain a secure and stable work environment, i.e., safeguard client information, cameras on during work meetings, and provide a current updated photo. This is a core value of our culture and an essential job function for each of us.
 Travel Requirements:

 This is a remote position.
 Salary Range
$151000.00 To $200500.00 / year Benefits & Perks
 The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives and restricted stock units as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including: 
 Medical, dental, and vision

 Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs

 Onboarding & Travel
 This is a remote role, with an in-person onboarding training component. New team members must participate in Trailhead , HealthEquity ’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations. 
 This role may begin with a virtual, self-paced onboarding experience, followed by a mandatory onsite Trailhead session at a later date.
 HealthEquity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to team members with qualifying disabilities. Should you be selected for this role and require an accommodation, we will put you in touch with our Benefits Team so you can begin the accommodation request process.

 HealthEquity uses Microsoft Copilot to transcribe screening interviews between candidates and their direct Talent Partner for note taking and interview summaries. By scheduling a screening interview with us, you consent to Microsoft Copilot’s AI technology recording and transcribing your interview with your Talent Partner. This information will be reviewed for accuracy and then used by HealthEquity to summarize the interview, ensure accuracy, and facilitate our hiring process. We take privacy seriously. You have the option to opt out. If you wish to opt out of this Microsoft Copilot transcription, please notify your Talent Partner in advance of the interview. If we do not receive an opt-out request from you, we will assume that you consent to the use of Microsoft Copilot.
 HealthEquity uses Pindrop Pulse during certain interviews to support identity verification, interview security, and fraud prevention. By scheduling and participating in an interview where Pindrop Pulse is enabled, you acknowledge that Pindrop's technology may analyze information such as voice, video, device, network, and location-related signals to identify potential impersonation, deepfake activity, and other security risks. This information may be reviewed by HealthEquity 's Talent Acquisition and Security teams to support a secure hiring process. All alerts and risk indicators are reviewed by trained personnel, and HealthEquity does not make hiring decisions based solely on automated analysis. We take privacy seriously. You have the option to opt out of Pindrop analysis. If you wish to opt out, please notify your Talent Partner in advance of the interview. If we do not receive an opt-out request from you before the interview, we will assume that you consent to HealthEquity 's use of Pindrop Pulse for security verification purposes during the hiring process. 
 At HealthEquity , our goal is to save and improve lives by empowering healthcare consumers. This shared purpose inspires everything we do, including how we approach hiring. Our process is designed to get to know the real you: your skills, experiences, and potential to make a difference. We value honesty, originality, and the courage to do the right thing, even when it is not the easiest path. Showing up as your authentic self reflects these values and helps us build something truly remarkable together.
 As AI is becoming a common tool throughout the application process, we want to be clear about its appropriate use at HealthEquity . Using AI to support resume writing, research, or interview preparation is perfectly acceptable, provided the content is accurate and genuinely represents your qualifications and skills. For other key parts of our interview process, however, it is important that the ideas, communication, and work you share reflect your own voice, experiences, and thinking. We ask that you participate in our live interviews and complete any assessments without AI assistance unless instructions explicitly indicate otherwise or a specific exception is discussed and approved in advance. This approach ensures fairness, celebrates your individuality, and allows your authentic perspective to shine. Behaviors that do not align with these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process or termination of employment if later discovered. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to learning about the unique contributions only you can bring to HealthEquity .
 HealthEquity is committed to your privacy as an applicant for employment. For information on our privacy policies and practices, please visit HealthEquity Privacy.
